annotations.title: Get One Migrant Program by Fiscal Year

description: One program of the Migrant Program Money Register by key: its label, agency and award-ID rule (the FAIN prefix pattern and the listings it is booked under, or the reviewed award list for contracts) with the register's evidence; the listing note where the program's money moved between assistance listings (the unaccompanied-children program booked under 93.566 from December 2024 and re-booked older obligations in September 2026, so a series by listing alone moves with that booking), and money by listing or by kind where the register gives it; by fiscal year, net obligations, positive obligations, de-obligations, transactions, recipients and new awards, each labelled with its fiscal year and the as-of date; the 10 largest recipients each fiscal year as the register ranks them, with their class; new awards in FY2025 and FY2026 by funding opportunity; the equal twelve-month windows; class shares by year; and, for State Reception and Placement, the awards placed outside the United States that are excluded. Every amount is an obligation from the award records (the government's commitment to pay), net of de-obligations, by action date; net obligations, positive obligations and de-obligations are separate stages, each labelled with its fiscal year and the as-of date, award-level outlays (only where the record carries them) are the record's cumulative figure to the as-of date, and they are never added across stages. Governments are kept apart from organisations: every amount names its recipient class from the register's reviewed table, never a single NGO total. A recipient is called an IRS-listed exempt organisation only where the register's IRS EO BMF match stands (by the reviewed EIN, or by exact name and state where the register marks the match by rule), shown with that record; other organisations read organisation, IRS status not matched. The tools never call a recipient nonprofit or faith-based, and no recipient is classified by religion. Lobbying reports (LDA), connected PACs (FEC), ICE and CBP contracts (the Pay-to-Play Register, where ICE detention sits) and super PAC gifts (the Super PAC Donors Register) are side columns: shown side by side, never added to program money and never put in date sequence with an award or a termination. Every answer carries the register's question note: these records show federal awards and the agencies' own termination records; they do not show how any recipient used the money or why an award was made or ended beyond what the record says. Every answer also carries the side-by-side caption, the as-of and retrieval dates, each file's date, the source page on morvs.ai and the licence. Institutions only: no beneficiary, staff member, executive or sole proprietor is named; withheld recipients and records appear only as counts and amounts.

program.description: Required program key: orr_uc, orr_refugee_formula, orr_refugee_matching, orr_refugee_discretionary, orr_contracts, state_rp, fema_ssp or eoir_legal_access.
